tables.name: Shinkira Naming Method
tables.description: Which naming method a Shinkira settlement name uses. Each result is a naming method; its faces are its weight (starter weights 70% / 30%). Romanised, Japanese-inspired forms used as temporary creative data; not a complete or historically accurate naming system.

results.name: Geographic Compound
results.description: First element + second element as one word, e.g. Kirisawa, Mizumura.

results.name: Historical Founder
results.description: A family or founder name + a settlement element as one word, without an English possessive, e.g. Takedamura, Mizunosato.
